rows.label: Denim / heavy twill
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: Wilcom 'About auto fabrics' (density reduced, minimal pull compensation, longer stitches). Physical sew-out pending.

rows.label: T-shirt / stretch knit
rows.stabilizer: Cut-away (no-show mesh for light shirts). Never tear-away on knits.
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: Wilcom 'About auto fabrics' (pull increased, extra underlay, density slightly reduced); Hatch blog: cut-away for knits. Physical sew-out pending.

rows.label: Polo / piqué knit
rows.stabilizer: Cut-away; a water-soluble topping keeps stitches out of the piqué texture.
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: Wilcom 'About auto fabrics' (extra edge and zigzag underlay, density slightly looser). Physical sew-out pending.

rows.label: Fleece / sweatshirt
rows.stabilizer: Cut-away plus water-soluble topping so stitches sit on the pile.
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: Wilcom 'About auto fabrics' (wider spacing, heavy underlay, pull increased) and its pull guideline of about 0.40 mm for fleece. Physical sew-out pending.

rows.label: Towel / terry
rows.stabilizer: Tear-away plus water-soluble topping; a dense underlay flattens the loops.
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: pile fabrics need topping and a flattening underlay (backing.json pile.topping); values extrapolated from the fleece preset. Physical sew-out pending.

rows.label: Satin / silk / fine
rows.stabilizer: Light cut-away or fusible; use a fine needle.
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: Wilcom 'About auto fabrics' (density and pull reduced, fine stitch lengths, minimal underlay). Physical sew-out pending.

rows.label: Nylon / sports fabric
rows.stabilizer: Light cut-away; avoid too many needle holes close together.
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: Wilcom 'About auto fabrics' (extra edge underlay, moderate pull, shorter stitches). Physical sew-out pending.

rows.label: Cap / structured
rows.source_note: Auto Fabric starting values, 2026-10-20: Wilcom 'About auto fabrics' (tighter density, strong edge underlay, increased tie-offs). Physical sew-out pending.
